changeSet.sql: create table sections ( id bigint generated by default as identity, nom varchar(100) not null, type varchar(20) not null, primary key (id), unique (nom), check (type in ('COMPETITION', 'NON_COMPETITIVE')) )
insert into sections (nom, type) select distinct groupe_filtre, groupe from activites where groupe_filtre is not null and trim(groupe_filtre) <> '' and groupe in ('COMPETITION', 'NON_COMPETITIVE')
